thesis: Hold at the 11:00 ET tick. Sizing book is still one name: VTI about $249 (~25% of ~$999 equity) and cash about $750 (~75%), inside the 15% cash floor, 35% single-name cap, and 6-position limit. Items published after the prior tick and before 15:00Z are not rotation catalysts: Federal Home Loan Bank of Indianapolis and Topeka 8-Ks are Item 2.03 debt obligations, Tri-State Generation filed an officer Item 5.02, Stone Point Credit Income Fund filed Item 8.01 with no figures, and Silexion Therapeutics filed a material agreement plus an unregistered equity sale (dilution on a microcap, not a balanced add). Carryover context is unchanged and cautious: junk bonds on track for their worst month since 2022, the 10-year yield at 5.259% and slightly higher with TLT down 0.73%, oil and USO weaker, and VIX at 16 slightly lower. Mike Wilson's large-cap quality comment is already expressed by the existing VTI sleeve. No new quantified catalyst to add a second name, add duration or credit, or sell the broad-market ballast.
